'''Sathir Temple''' was a temple located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Quolas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]]. Most of the temple's surfaces were covered with carvings, many of which portrayed the ancestors of the city's residents.<ref name="CotG" />
